description: Wave readiness. A wave may pin its source commit only when every listed bead has required_status at that commit's .beads/issues.jsonl export. bead_ids are full identifiers in the source tracker. Issue count never changes wave count.

U1.acceptance_check: Destination-authored control files only; no upstream dependency.

U2.acceptance_check: Four active source crates compile and test through the destination workspace; golden vectors reproduce from the in-tree generator.

U3.acceptance_check: Module host and shared-memory IPC land; host-runtime, transport, tokenizer vectors pass from destination-only sources.

U4.acceptance_check: Semantic kernel lands through daemon routes and rip-out; every persistent family has a class contract.

U5.acceptance_check: Rust parity and retrieval land; no unclassified TypeScript mutation path remains.

U7.acceptance_check: No readiness beads beyond U5; permanent TypeScript surfaces and packaging land.

U8.acceptance_check: All gating work of U3, U4, U5 complete at the final reconciled commit.
